title: NBA Logo Quiz Part 3: Hard Mode
headline: NBA Logo Quiz Part 3: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NBA logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NBA team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NBA team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.piece: One of the small blue stars trailing the ball, with its black outline.
items.fact: The Magic unveiled this logo on June 3, 2025, bringing back the star from their 1990s look with a trail of stars behind the ball.

items.piece: The right side of the red ring around the R, with its gold edge.
items.fact: The Rockets introduced their red R in 2003. It is drawn to look like a rocket with exhaust trails.

items.piece: The tip of the hornet's left wing: purple, teal and silver.
items.fact: Michael Jordan unveiled the current Hornets logo in December 2013. It brought back the purple and teal of the original 1988 Hornets.

items.piece: The torn edge of one claw mark across the red ball.
items.fact: The Raptors' claw-marked basketball was announced in December 2014 and designed by Sid Lee, the agency behind We The North.

items.piece: The green outer ring above the blue and silver top of the circle.
items.fact: The Timberwolves unveiled this logo in April 2017. It shows a howling wolf and a North Star for Minnesota.

items.piece: White lines from the bottom of the ship, against navy.
items.fact: The Clippers unveiled this logo in February 2024: a ship inside a C ringed by compass points, a nod to the nautical roots of the name.

items.piece: The gold streaks trailing behind the ball on the left.
items.fact: The Suns' basketball sunburst took its current form in June 2013, the primary logo's first change in 13 years.

items.piece: A silver and black corner of the spur's arm.
items.fact: The spur in the Spurs' logo comes from the team's original mark, drawn by San Antonio artist Finis Collins in the 1970s.
